# Wharf 0.5.0 host and Docker preflight plan

1. Define injectable host-check contracts and stable result/exit-code mapping.
2. Implement platform, Docker reachability, and capacity probes with no
   configuration mutation or Docker resource creation.
3. Add `wharf check` text and JSON output plus
   `--allow-unsupported-host`.
4. Add fake-probe tests for override safety, blocking failures, and success;
   exercise the compiled command on the current supported host.
5. Run format, build, tests, and the validation script. Record changes and
   review evidence. Do not merge or tag this branch in Session 5.
